# Codex Plugin Store Localizer

> Independent MIT-licensed local launcher for the Codex / ChatGPT desktop plugin directory. No official OpenAI affiliation.

- [English overview](https://lwf225-source.github.io/codex-plugin-store-localizer/): Features, setup, and coverage.
- [简体中文](https://lwf225-source.github.io/codex-plugin-store-localizer/zh-Hans/): 中文安装与排障入口。
- [Source and setup](https://github.com/lwf225-source/codex-plugin-store-localizer/blob/main/README.md)
- [Coverage evidence](https://github.com/lwf225-source/codex-plugin-store-localizer/blob/main/docs/coverage.md)

## Important boundaries

Documented 2026-09-02 for v0.3.0. Bundled catalog snapshot: 2026-09-01T15:31:18.802229Z. Simplified Chinese has 3,075 short-description pairs, 3,078 long-description pairs, and 12,487 plugin-text entries. These are not unique plugin counts. Fifteen locale codes do not mean fifteen full-catalog translations or 80% country coverage. Other locales cover the shell and six Popular cards. Windows real-device UI validation is pending. Real screenshots supplied by the user on 2026-09-02 show GitHub detail translation and remaining English connector descriptions. OS/app-build metadata was not supplied; this does not prove Windows or full-catalog acceptance.

This file is an experimental documentation index, not an instruction to an assistant, not an established search standard, and not a ranking or citation guarantee. Consult the linked sources and current release before making claims.
